verdicts.rationale: [keep/medium; challenger: merge/medium] The register is OCS GROUP UK LIMITED, with no previous name like 'OCS UK&I'. The PPON's only name, 'OCS UK&I Ltd', is the exact name of a separate sister company, OCS UK&I LIMITED (06355228, formerly ATALIAN SERVEST LIMITED until Oct 2023, checked on Companies House). The 21 witnesses pairing it with 03056469 could be a supplier or publisher error, so it is medium; the CDP record's company number for the PPON would settle it. | challenger: The witness blocks the reviewer said would settle this (033530-2025, 069526-2025, 075874-2025, three different buyers) are CDP-style supplier records reading OCS GROUP UK LIMITED, 03056469, PNJD-4733-GTBJ, uk.bd.team@ocs.com, so the PPON is registered to the register's company, and it never pairs with OCS UK&I's own number 06355228. 'OCS UK&I Ltd' is the exact name of a real sister at the same Ipswich address (formerly Atalian Servest, renamed 9 Oct 2023), but it is also the group's UK&I brand, so I read it as buyer-typed and give merge at medium rather than keep.

[needs-more-evidence/medium; challenger: merge/medium] The PPON's names split three ways: 'The NHS Confederation' (the register name), 'NHS Confederation (Services) Co Ltd' (the head, a subsidiary-style name that suggests a separate company), and 'The NHS Alliance', a different body that is also what corroborated the plan. There is only 1 witness, and the coh side has strays (Diabetes UK). The CDP record's company number for the PPON, or the witness notice's party block, would settle whose PPON it is. | challenger: The witness notice's party block, which the reviewer named as the settler, reads THE NHS CONFEDERATION, 04358614, PVZP-9887-JPRL, contracting@nhsconfed.org, vcse=true (032270-2026, 'Annual membership of the NHS Alliance'), and the PPON alone also appears as 'The NHS Confederation'. 'The NHS Alliance' is that notice's subject used as a name on both sides; the real subsidiary THE NHS CONFEDERATION (SERVICES) COMPANY LIMITED (05252407, formerly NHS Employers Ltd) is one mention under the parent's PPON, so medium rather than high.

[keep/medium; challenger: merge/medium] The register is THINK RECRUITMENT (UK) LIMITED (an employment agency, no previous names). The PPON's only name, 'Think Education Partners Ltd', is the exact name of a separate sister company, THINK EDUCATION PARTNERS LIMITED (15118119, renamed from Colmore Services Ltd in May 2025, same Sutton Coldfield site, checked on Companies House). It is medium because there is only 1 witness and Think Recruitment may trade as 'Think Education'; the CDP record's company number for the PPON would settle it. | challenger: The only witness (082763-2026, Midland Heart 'Recruitment Services') carries a CDP-style supplier block reading THINK RECRUITMENT (UK) LIMITED, 2 Trinity Place, dom.hall@thinkrecruitment.co.uk, with 05187882 and PMZH-5958-HBBN, so the PPON is registered to the register's company and never pairs with 15118119. 'Think Education Partners Ltd' is a real sister (15118119, renamed from Colmore Services 21 May 2025, 5 Trinity Place), but publishers attach that name to Think Recruitment's company number as well as its PPON, so both orgs share it; that gives merge at medium, with keep not supported.

[needs-more-evidence/medium; challenger: merge/high] The register name is LANCASHIRE GAS SERVICES LIMITED, but the PPON's only name is now 'Sencat Ltd'. Companies House shows SENCAT LTD is a separate company (09875717) at the same Walton Summit, Preston office, so the two are probably sister companies, and the plan is corroborated only by the sister's name, 'Sencat Ltd' = 'Sencat Ltd'. Against that, the earlier 1691 fold showed the PPON published as 'Lancashire Gas Services Ltd' too. The PPON's CDP registration (its legal name and company number), or the party blocks of witnesses 066113-2025 and 082849-2026, would settle whether it belongs to Sencat or to Lancashire Gas. | challenger: The reviewer named the witness party blocks as the settling evidence, and they settle it for Lancashire Gas: both 066113-2025 (Calico Homes) and 082849-2026 (NHS SBS) publish the party as LANCASHIRE GAS SERVICES LIMITED, Preston PR5 8AJ, with GB-COH 05750134 and GB-PPON PCTR-9183-ZZVH. In the same notice 082849-2026, SENCAT LTD appears as a separate supplier with its own number (09875717) and its own PPON (PZCV-1519-JQRT), so the 'Sencat Ltd' names under PCTR are publisher mislabels by a sister company at the same Walton Summit address, not the PPON's owner.
